
	<div class="postTitle">
		<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ioriwellings/p/19952340" title="发布于 2026-04-29 15:56">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">用VC6 App调用第三方Java WebService后的结果字符串乱码问题的解决！</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>我们通过接口传递webservice后，它返回信息为“涓婁紶鎴愬姛!”&nbsp;<br>乱码是以Unicode形式展现的中文，它的Utf-8形式的字节码16进制为：<br>00000000h: E4 B8 8A E4 BC A0 E6 88 90 E5 8A 9F 21&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;; 涓婁紶鎴愬姛!..</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>| 乱码字符 | GBK 编码 (十六进制) |
|----------|---------------------|
| 涓       | `<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">E4 B8</span>`             |
| 婁       | `<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">8A</span> <span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)">E4</span>`             |
| 紶       | `<span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)">BC A0</span>`             |
| 鎴       | `<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">E6 88</span>`             |
| 夽       | `<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">90</span> E5`             |
| 姛       | `8A 9F`             |</pre>
</div>
<p>同样的还可以将这个16进制用UTF-8 格式每三个字节码显示一个中文：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>E4 B8 8A → <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">上</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
E4 BC A0 → </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">传</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
E6 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">88</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span> → <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
E5 8A 9F → </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">功</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">21</span>       → <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>所以我们要还原这个过程将GBK乱码反解成utf-8的原始字节，再将utf-8格式转成unicode，就能正确在VC中 messagebox了，<a class="post-item-author" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ioriwellings" target="_blank">不及格的程序员-八神</a></p>
<p>其实事情并不是这样的简单，首先它传回来时并不是以e4b88a 这种utf-8 原始码传回来的，现在我们看到的都是系统平台转换后的，后面我为了捕捉原始码上了代理软件截取了通信的二进制原始信息！它不仅可以返回成功信息，还可以返回错误信息<br>//下面为上传失败的返回错误信息</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span>涓婁紶澶辫触锛佷紒涓氬敮涓�鏍囪瘑鐮侀獙璇佷笉閫氳繃锛�</span></pre>
</div>
<p>//返回的乱码翻译过来：上传失败！企业唯?? 标识码验证不通过??， 正常脑补后修正实际应为"上传失败！企业唯一标识码验证不通过！"<br>下面我们来分析一下为什么没有正确解码</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>现在拿出乱码部分 utf-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">16的 中文显示：涓婁紶澶辫触锛佷紒涓氬敮涓�鏍囪瘑鐮侀獙璇佷笉閫氳繃锛�

00000010h: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span> 7D <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">93</span> 6D 2C 6C 6E <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">65</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">93</span> 6D FD FF <span style="text-decoration: underline">CD <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1); text-decoration: underline">93</span></span> EA <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">56</span> ; .}搈,lne搈?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">蛽闢          //cd93 = 镙

然后 好巧不巧地 与 UTF</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span> 格式的 gbk式 解码 高度相似 ，中文为：<span style="text-decoration: underline; color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">上传失败！企业唯?? 标识码验证不通过??</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 

00000000h: <span style="text-decoration: underline">E4 B8 8A</span> E4 BC A0 E5 A4 B1 E8 B4 A5 EF BC </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> E4 ; 涓婁紶澶辫触锛佷
00000010h: BC </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span> E4 B8 9A E5 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">94</span> AF <span style="text-decoration: underline">E4 B8 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1); text-decoration: underline">20</span></span> E6 A0 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">87</span> E8 AF ; 紒涓氬敮涓 鏍囪? //??(E4B820)标(e6a087)识(E8AF86)码(E7A081)<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
00000020h: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">86</span> E7 A0 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span> E9 AA 8C E8 AF <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span> E4 B8 8D E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span> 9A ; 嗙爜楠岃瘉涓嶉€?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
00000030h: E8 BF </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">87</span> EF BC <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>                               ; 杩囷?</pre>
</div>
<p>通过以上对比，结论是 乱码的GBK编码的16进制就是它的 正确UTF-8格式的字节码，就是说将这些字节按utf-8格式解码就显示出正确的中文了</p>
<p>FDFF，是未能找到映射字符被充的空白占位符，未能被解析，也不能还原，原始码已丢失。 == UTF-8 : EF BF BD&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>HTTP/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

</div>

<p>&nbsp;到目前为止，我们认为它是 将utf-8的文字gbk编码了一次，又再utf-8的输出给客户端，当时我就想用java来还原这个过程，看看我猜的对不对<br>但是我是在android手机的java环境测试的 ,代码如下</p>

<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">04</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">43.069</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span> System.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>              com.bosd.javatest                    I  构造的字节序列: E6 B6 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">93</span> E5 A9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> E7 B4 B6 E6 BE B6 E8 BE AB E8
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">04</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">43.071</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span> System.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>              com.bosd.javatest                    I                        A7 A6 E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">94</span> 9B E4 BD B7 E7 B4 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">92</span> E6 B6 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">93</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> E6 B0
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">04</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">43.073</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span> System.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>              com.bosd.javatest                    I                        AC E6 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95</span> AE E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">94</span> 9F E8 8A A5 E7 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">88</span> A3 E7 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">92</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">87</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">04</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">43.075</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span> System.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>              com.bosd.javatest                    I                        E5 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">97</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">99</span> E7 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">88</span> 9C E6 A5 A0 E5 B2 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">83</span> E7 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">98</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">89</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> E6
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">04</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">43.077</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span> System.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>              com.bosd.javatest                    I                        B6 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">93</span> E5 B6 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">89</span> E2 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">82</span> AC E6 B0 B3 E7 B9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">83</span> E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">94</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">04</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">43.078</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29708</span> System.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>              com.bosd.javatest                    I                        9B EF BF BD</pre>
</div>
<p>此时事件并没有结束，我们只是证明了它用GBK重新编码了UTF-8的中文，最后又把它转成UTF-8输出给客户端，并没有完全实现，好比是确定某人是杀人凶手，却没有发现作案工具，你说是刀口所至命的，那是什么刀，小李飞刀还是金丝大环刀呢? 无法在卷宗上结案啊，需要继续探究。<br>因为你会发现从信息"<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">上传失败！企业唯一标识码验证不通过！</span> " 到&nbsp;"<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">上传失败！企业唯??标识码验证不通过??</span>" 没有一个完整性论证<br>我的JAVA代码在中文还原时输出的是 "<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">上传失败！企业唯一标识码验证不通过�?</span>",用了许多方式来调试来调整字符串的拼接也没用，好气啊</p>
<p>每天都在脑中重复这个过程，我试着在头脑中解析这个GBK编码的方式，直觉一直告诉我我的方法没有问题测试也没有问题但返回的结果就是不对<br>返复在脑海里重现 解析 "一"字的 UTF-8编码（E4 B8 80）,E4 B8 用GBK来读就是涓， 0x80，GBK没有映射就应该是0xEFBFBD 替换符<br>涓的UTF-8字节码（E6 B6 93）但Win java 这里却返回了 欧元符号€，经过反复的思考后我觉得应该是Windows系统的问题，然后我就找到原生Linux Java 平台再次运行我同样的JAVA代码，结果不出所料的与我期望的结果一至了，我得到了如下输出：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 正确的原始消息: 上传失败！企业唯一标识码验证不通过！
Original UTF</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Hex
E4 B8 8A E4 BC A0 E5 A4 B1 E8 B4 A5 EF BC </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span> E4 BC <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span> E4 B8 9A E5 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">94</span> AF E4 B8 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span> E6 A0 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">87</span> E8 AF <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">86</span> E7 A0 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span> E9 AA 8C E8 AF <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span> E4 B8 8D E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span> 9A E8 BF <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">87</span> EF BC <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
After GBK Encode Utf</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Hex
E6 B6 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">93</span> E5 A9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span> E7 B4 B6 E6 BE B6 E8 BE AB E8 A7 A6 E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">94</span> 9B E4 BD B7 E7 B4 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">92</span> E6 B6 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">93</span> E6 B0 AC E6 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95</span> AE E6 B6 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">93</span> EF BF BD E9 8F 8D E5 9B AA E7 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">98</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">91</span> E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span> AE E4 BE <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span> E7 8D <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">99</span> E7 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">92</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">87</span> E4 BD B7 E7 AC <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">89</span> E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">96</span> AB E6 B0 B3 E7 B9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">83</span> E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">94</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 9B EF BF BD 
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 服务端错误解读后产生的乱码字符串: 涓婁紶澶辫触锛佷紒涓氬敮涓�鏍囪瘑鐮侀獙璇佷笉閫氳繃锛�
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>. 最终发送给客户端的 UTF-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 字节 (十六进制): 
E6 B6 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">93</span> E5 A9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">81</span> E7 B4 B6 E6 BE B6 E8 BE AB E8 A7 A6 E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">94</span> 9B E4 BD B7 E7 B4 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">92</span> E6 B6 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">93</span> E6 B0 AC E6 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95</span> AE <span style="text-decoration: underline; color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">E6 B6 <span style="text-decoration: underline">93</span> EF BF BD</span> E9 8F 8D E5 9B AA E7 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">98</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">91</span> E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span> AE E4 BE <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span> E7 8D <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">99</span> E7 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">92</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">87</span> E4 BD B7 E7 AC <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">89</span> E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">96</span> AB E6 B0 B3 E7 B9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">83</span> E9 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">94</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 9B EF BF BD 
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>. 客户端最终看到的内容: 涓婁紶澶辫触锛佷紒涓氬敮涓�鏍囪瘑鐮侀獙璇佷笉閫氳繃锛�</pre>
</div>
<p>这个结果让我觉得Windows 平台中GBK 编码中有微软自已的实现与扩充，比如对于 80 就被映射到了€符号.... 标准JAVA GBK编码并没有这个设定，它直接变成不可识别的标志字符串”EFBFBD“, 所以Webservice的平台是非Windows系统的java 标准 GBK 编码实现的，真相大白了。</p>
<p>这个编码策略的底层平台实现差异违背了 Java （WORA，Write Once, Run Anywhere）一次编写随处运行的理念，微软画蛇添足。</p>
<p>但是....第二天我时而翻来复去地在脑海里复现这个过程，想来想去发现一个细思极恐的问题，我的测试方法好像有问题，因为我是在Android手机上运行的程序，并没有在windows本身中运行java,那么我的结论还正确吗？<br>于是我又在Win 10上用命令行 编译了这段代码，并在命令行中运行结果与上面是一至的，是我错怪了Windows 冤枉了好人啊！于是再用GB18030(国标，严格的GBK标准)在手机上运行了一次，这回的结果是对的了， 说明是Android手机上的GBK有私自扩展将拉丁字符0x80映射过来了，可但是， windows api /.net 原生app调用GBK编码的结果同样是被映射的，它执行的CodePage936扩展行为，也不算冤枉。<br>//下面为android手机中的gbk解码器描述，手机兼容了 cp936的行为。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>corruptedString = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> String(wrongGbkBytes,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">gbk</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span> = {CharsetICU@<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5219</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">} 
 icuCanonicalName </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">windows-936-2000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">" 这是android手机中的编码器名子</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 aliasSet </span>= {Collections$UnmodifiableSet@<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5223</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">} 
 aliases </span>=  [GBK, iso-ir-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">58</span>, csISO58GB231280, csGB2312, chinese, MS936, GB_2312-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span>, GB2312, windows-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">936</span>, CP936]</pre>
</div>
<p>GBK解码时是按双字节读取中文，但utf-8是三字节表示中文，所以反复编解码会产生字节丢失变成了\uFFFD，就不能还原成原来的中文了。</p>
<p>这是服务端的webservice错误编码中文所至，所以我们客户端现在只能提示"上传失败！企业唯??标识码验证不通过??" ,哦不， 我们手动替换一下吧 手动把错误信息修正.</p>
<div><a class="post-item-author" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ioriwellings" target="_blank">不及格的程序员-八神</a></div>

<p>======================个性签名=====================</p>
<p>之前认为Apple 的iOS 设计的要比 Android 稳定,我错了吗?</p>
<p>下载的许多客户端程序/游戏程序,经常会Crash,是程序写的不好(内存泄漏?刚启动也会吗?)还是iOS本身的不稳定!!!</p>
<p>如果在Android手机中可以简单联接到ddms,就可以查看系统log,很容易看到程序为什么出错,在iPhone中如何得知呢?试试Organizer吧,分析一下Device logs,也许有用.</p>
<p><img src="http://pic002.cnblogs.com/images/2010/47234/2010111611330257.jpg" width="780px" height="350px" alt="我的开发工具">
<br>
</p><p style="display:none">
对于博客园里的网友,不敢称为叫"程序员"的人,你们攻击性太强,看来你们是不会想到我的用意的.园子里有不少人都非常喜欢Jeffrey,是因为它的第一版 框架设计 CLR via C#.<br>
可是从第一版到现在的第三版,没有看到真正底层的东西,内容仅仅是比MSDN文档更丰富一些,可能是我的要求太高了吧.<br>
也就是因为它很多时候会接触到微软开发人员,会经常聊聊某些问题而已,而它又将这些问题反应到书中.也许它就像一个小记者.<br>
它的年龄大我们不多,我的孩子与它小儿子一般大,如果我能向它那样出入微软与它们开发人员长时间交流,不仅仅会牛成它这样.....<br>
可是微软的开发人员不会扔太多时间在它这儿的.所以它会整天追着这个,赶它那个..屁颠个不停吧...<br>
而它的另一版被称为好书的 Windows核心编程,更是没有什么深度可言,仅仅是将windows提供的api,以及内核功能再重申了一遍.<br>
这些书对晋及编程知识是有些贡献的,再说一遍我不是在匾低谁,说说想法而已.
</p>
